children: US crude oil inventories rose, while gasoline and distillate stocks fell last week, market sources said on Tuesday, citing data from the American Petroleum Institute.
Crude stocks rose by 1.8 million barrels in the week ended September 18, the sources said, on the condition of anonymity.
Gasoline and distillate inventories both fell by about 2.2 million barrels, respectively, compared with a week earlier, the sources said.
